title: Landing: project covers blank when sidecars hold an old folder path
description: 62 of 76 projects show no cover on the landing page. findRecentProjectThumbnail (routes/projects.js) trusts each sidecar's absolute filePath; projects moved by the MPI-708 Cubric Vision -> Cubric Studio rename (or copied between projects) fail pathExists on every candidate. The landing scan must resolve a stale path the way the project-open relocation heal does, read-only. Also check audio-last projects (waveform thumb).
